```{=html}
<style>
:root {
  --shift-bg: #050708;
  --shift-bg-2: #0a0f11;
  --shift-panel: rgba(13, 20, 22, 0.88);
  --shift-panel-strong: rgba(17, 28, 30, 0.96);
  --shift-line: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.26);
  --shift-line-cyan: rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.28);
  --shift-text: #f2f7f4;
  --shift-muted: #a7b7b1;
  --shift-muted-2: #73827d;
  --shift-neon: #b7ff2a;
  --shift-cyan: #17d7c6;
  --shift-cyan-soft: #6df7ea;
  --shift-danger: #ff5f8d;
  --shift-radius: 8px;
  --shift-shadow: 0 22px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
  --shift-max: 1160px;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  background: var(--shift-bg);
  color: var(--shift-text);
}

.navbar {
  background: rgba(5, 7, 8, 0.9) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
}

.navbar .navbar-brand,
.navbar .navbar-nav .nav-link,
.navbar .dropdown-item {
  color: rgba(242, 247, 244, 0.9) !important;
}

.navbar .navbar-brand:hover,
.navbar .navbar-nav .nav-link:hover,
.navbar .dropdown-item:hover {
  color: var(--shift-neon) !important;
}

.navbar .dropdown-menu {
  background: #0b1012;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.22);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shift-shadow);
}

.navbar .dropdown-item:hover,
.navbar .dropdown-item:focus {
  background: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.08);
}

.navbar-logo {
  max-height: 36px;
  width: auto;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

#quarto-content,
#quarto-document-content {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

main.content,
.page-layout-full main.content {
  max-width: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.page-layout-full .column-page,
.page-layout-full .column-page-left,
.page-layout-full .column-page-right,
.page-layout-full .column-screen {
  max-width: none !important;
}

.shift-page {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 8%, rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.12), transparent 24rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 0%, rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.13), transparent 28rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #050708 0%, #071012 48%, #050708 100%);
  color: var(--shift-text);
  font-family: Pretendard, Inter, "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

.shift-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 44px 44px;
  mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), transparent 88%);
}

.shift-page::after {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025) 0,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025) 1px,
    transparent 1px,
    transparent 5px
  );
  opacity: 0.18;
}

.shift-page a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.shift-shell {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.shift-container {
  width: min(var(--shift-max), calc(100% - 40px));
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.shift-hero {
  min-height: 82svh;
  display: grid;
  align-items: center;
  padding: clamp(72px, 9vw, 116px) 0 clamp(44px, 6vw, 76px);
}

.hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.06fr) minmax(320px, 0.74fr);
  gap: clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px);
  align-items: center;
}

.eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: fit-content;
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.34);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.06);
  color: var(--shift-neon);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.12);
}

.eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--shift-neon);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--shift-neon);
}

.hero-logo-title {
  margin: 0;
}

.hero-logo {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(148px, 28vw, 260px);
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 18px;
  filter:
    drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.32))
    drop-shadow(0 0 38px rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.18));
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.hero-copy {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 26px 0 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: clamp(1.04rem, 1.8vw, 1.28rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.hero-copy strong {
  color: var(--shift-cyan-soft);
  font-weight: 750;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 34px;
}

.shift-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 46px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.42);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.08);
  color: var(--shift-text);
  font-weight: 760;
  line-height: 1.1;
  transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease;
}

.shift-btn:hover,
.shift-btn:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.92);
  background: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.15);
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.18);
}

.shift-btn.primary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--shift-neon), #7df7b1);
  color: #06100b;
  box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.24);
}

.shift-btn.primary:hover,
.shift-btn.primary:focus-visible {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d6ff6a, var(--shift-cyan-soft));
}

.shift-btn.ghost {
  border-color: rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.38);
  background: rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.07);
}

.shift-btn.ghost:hover,
.shift-btn.ghost:focus-visible {
  border-color: rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.86);
  box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.16);
}

.hero-visual {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.32);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16, 27, 30, 0.94), rgba(6, 11, 12, 0.94)),
    #0a0f11;
  box-shadow:
    var(--shift-shadow),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025),
    0 0 42px rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.12);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-visual::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 12%, rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.13) 12% 12.5%, transparent 12.5% 100%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 62%, rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.16) 62% 62.5%, transparent 62.5% 100%);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.visual-topbar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.2);
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 720;
}

.window-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.window-dots span {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--shift-muted-2);
}

.window-dots span:nth-child(1) {
  background: var(--shift-danger);
}

.window-dots span:nth-child(2) {
  background: var(--shift-neon);
}

.window-dots span:nth-child(3) {
  background: var(--shift-cyan);
}

.visual-body {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 22px;
}

.signal-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
}

.signal-card {
  min-height: 92px;
  padding: 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(4, 8, 8, 0.68);
}

.signal-card b {
  display: block;
  color: var(--shift-neon);
  font-size: clamp(1.28rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  line-height: 1;
}

.signal-card span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 9px;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.terminal-stack {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.terminal-line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.22);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.045);
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.terminal-line span:first-child {
  color: var(--shift-cyan-soft);
}

.terminal-line span:last-child {
  color: var(--shift-neon);
}

.section-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 18px 0 0;
}

.section-nav a {
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 680;
}

.section-nav a:hover,
.section-nav a:focus-visible {
  border-color: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.5);
  color: var(--shift-neon);
}

.shift-section {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(70px, 9vw, 116px) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
}

.shift-section.compact {
  padding-top: clamp(54px, 8vw, 88px);
}

.section-head {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.72fr) minmax(280px, 0.38fr);
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: end;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.kicker {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: var(--shift-neon);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.shift-section h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-text);
  font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.02;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.section-note {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.split-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.95fr) minmax(320px, 0.65fr);
  gap: clamp(22px, 4vw, 44px);
  align-items: start;
}

.lead-box {
  padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.22);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: var(--shift-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shift-shadow);
}

.lead-box p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: clamp(1.02rem, 1.6vw, 1.16rem);
  line-height: 1.82;
}

.lead-box p + p {
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.stat-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}

.stat-item {
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.24);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.045);
}

.stat-item strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--shift-cyan-soft);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.stat-item span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 7px;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

.shift-card {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100%;
  padding: 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.085);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(17, 29, 31, 0.95), rgba(9, 14, 16, 0.95));
  box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease;
}

.shift-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--shift-neon), var(--shift-cyan));
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.shift-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.36);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 52px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34), 0 0 22px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.08);
}

.card-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding: 6px 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.32);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--shift-cyan-soft);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 760;
}

.shift-card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-text);
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  line-height: 1.34;
}

.shift-card p {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.72;
}

.timeline {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  counter-reset: curriculum;
}

.timeline-item {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.18);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(7, 13, 14, 0.86);
}

.timeline-item::before {
  counter-increment: curriculum;
  content: "0" counter(curriculum);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.42);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.08);
  color: var(--shift-neon);
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.timeline-item h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-text);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
}

.timeline-item p {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.68;
}

.project-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

.project-card {
  min-height: 250px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.24);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.105), transparent 44%),
    rgba(9, 15, 17, 0.92);
}

.project-card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-text);
  font-size: 1.28rem;
}

.project-card p {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.72;
}

.project-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 22px;
}

.project-meta span {
  padding: 6px 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.22);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.045);
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.recruit-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.76fr) minmax(280px, 0.42fr);
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: stretch;
  padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 34px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.28);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background:
    linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.1), transparent 38%),
    rgba(10, 17, 18, 0.94);
  box-shadow: 0 0 44px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.08), var(--shift-shadow);
}

.recruit-panel h2 {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.recruit-panel p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.78;
}

.recruit-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 22px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.recruit-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 20px;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.recruit-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.72em;
  left: 0;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--shift-neon);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(183, 255, 42, 0.7);
}

.recruit-side {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}

.mini-panel {
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(23, 215, 198, 0.24);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(3, 8, 9, 0.72);
}

.mini-panel strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--shift-cyan-soft);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.mini-panel span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.contact-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.contact-item {
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.085);
  border-radius: var(--shift-radius);
  background: rgba(11, 17, 19, 0.86);
}

.contact-item strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--shift-neon);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.contact-item span,
.contact-item a {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 9px;
  color: var(--shift-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.shift-footer {
  padding: 34px 0 54px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
  color: var(--shift-muted-2);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.footer-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.footer-row a {
  color: var(--shift-cyan-soft);
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .hero-grid,
  .section-head,
  .split-layout,
  .recruit-panel {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .hero-visual {
    max-width: 640px;
  }

  .card-grid,
  .contact-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .shift-container {
    width: min(100% - 28px, var(--shift-max));
  }

  .shift-hero {
    min-height: auto;
    padding-top: 58px;
  }

  .hero-logo {
    width: clamp(136px, 48vw, 220px);
  }

  .hero-copy {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .hero-actions,
  .section-nav {
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .shift-btn {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .section-nav a {
    flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 8px);
    text-align: center;
  }

  .signal-row,
  .card-grid,
  .project-grid,
  .contact-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .terminal-line {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .timeline-item {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .timeline-item::before {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="shift-page">
  <div class="shift-shell">
    <header class="shift-hero" id="hero">
      <div class="shift-container">
        <div class="hero-grid">
          <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">Academic Tech Community</p>
            <h1 class="hero-logo-title">
              <img class="hero-logo" src="SHIFT 로고.svg" alt="SHIFT 로고">
              <span class="sr-only">SHIFT</span>
```
